messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated gateway 5xx and timeout rates detected on /v1/generate across us-west-2. Error rate spike from 0.3% -> 12% in last 3m. Paging oncall @Emma :rotating_light:
Emma: I’m on it, pulling logs. Can someone confirm if Dedicated pools are showing high queue depth?
Raj: yes, scheduler-metrics show batching queue length spiking on pool-gpu-a: avg queue_size=420, head_of_line=35ms.
Lucy: seeing KV cache growth on the same hosts, memory pressure + GC spikes around the same timeframe.
Emma: ok primary hypothesis: batching/scheduler saturation causing HOL blocking leading to gateway timeouts. Start mitigation plan: 1) open fallback route to lightweight-model, 2) temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 32, 3) evict oldest low-priority batches.
Michael: I can flip the route and apply batch_size override. Pushing config now.
deploy-bot: executing run: `rb config set route /v1/generate fallback_model=lightweight-v1 --env prod --region us-west-2`
deploy-bot: success — routing rule applied (hash: a1c3f).
Emma: Michael, reduce batch size on pool-gpu-a scheduler: `rb scheduler update pool-gpu-a --max-batch 32 --grace 500ms`
Michael: running...
ops-bot: API call results: 200 OK.
Michael: done. Confirming metrics: queue_size dropping from 420 -> 110 over 90s. HOL latency improving.
Raj: still seeing some 5xx on the gateway; traces point to requests backed by long KV cache coldloads that time out at the model runtime layer.
Lucy: I’m going to evict and compact KV segments on the affected hosts to free memory, will coordinate with Michael for low-impact windows.
Emma: Good. Also enabling autoscale burst on Dedicated pool to absorb remaining backlog.
Michael: autoscale burst enabled (+20% GPUs) for pool-gpu-a.
Emma: customer impact assessment: looks like 3% of requests in us-west-2 failed with 5xx during the peak window (1718001200-1718001400). No customer-facing page sent yet. Recommend holding public comms until we confirm residual error under 0.5% for 15m.
Raj: putting a quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM errors WHERE code LIKE '5%' AND region='us-west-2' AND ts BETWEEN 1718001200 AND 1718001400;` -> 17234 errors. Correlate with traffic: 570k requests in window -> ~3% as Emma said.
Lucy: KV compaction in progress on host-12, host-14, host-15. Progress: host-12 done, host-14 at 60%, host-15 queued.
Emma: thanks. Any sign of customer retries or SLO breaches?
Michael: some clients hit 502/retry increased but our retry policy mitigated most; still seeing elevated latency for streaming clients.
Emma: action items: 1) keep fallback route vs lightweight model for next 30m, 2) maintain reduced batch size until queue stabilizes for 15m, 3) finish KV compaction and monitor memory/GCs, 4) post a short internal incident summary to #general once stable.
Raj: adding a temporary backpressure rule at API gateway to cap burst from heavy clients to reduce thundering herd: `gatewayctl rate-limit add 10.0.0.0/16 50rps` (test)
Emma: good idea. Michael/Raj coordinate.
Lucy: compaction finished on host-14; host-15 compaction started and done. Memory usage dropped ~28% after compaction. Garbage collector frequency down.
Michael: metrics look healthier: 5xx rate down to 0.4% in us-west-2 over last 5m. Latency p50/p95 coming back to normal.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation measures applied: fallback routing, batch_size reduction, KV compaction, autoscale burst.
Emma: switching to handoff mode in 10 minutes. If things remain stable, move to monitoring and postmortem.
Raj: leaving notes in runbook: "scheduler-hol-eviction" checklist updated with thresholds and steps.
Lucy: tagging relevant infra PRs for long-term fix (improved KV eviction heuristics + scheduler throttles).
Michael: thumbs up.
Emma: thanks team. I’ll prepare initial incident summary and timeline. If any regressions, reopen this thread or page oncall. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed to pager at 1718001540 (acknowledged).
